en: Do you have an Excadrill? I'd swap my Ambipom for one. Let's trade!
Great! Ambidexter knows Nasty Plot. I'll make your Excadrill really strong.
That isn't an Excadrill. It's an Excadrill I want.
I see. That's your trusty partner. If you change your mind, let's trade.
Oh! Could you give me a Hippowdon, too? I'd trade you my Alakazam for it!
Wonderful! Beardy knows Psycho Cut. I'll make your Hippowdon really tough.
That isn't a Hippowdon. It's a Hippowdon I want.
I see. Come back if you change your mind about swapping.
I'm so glad we got to trade Pokémon! Ambidexter and Beardy are lucky to have you.
